A '''Spell of Protection''' was a [[Dathomir Magic|spell]] that could be cast by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. It protected a witch by creating a bubble of energy around [[Gender/Legends|her]]. The shield blocked both energy and physical matter.<ref name="CTD" />
